## Why This Is Asked
Addresses real-world risk of manual SG drift breaking SAP PrivateLink RFC paths. Tests ability to design an automated, auditable control plane and integration with AWS Config/Lambda.

```yaml
Resources:
  DriftGuardRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument: { Version: '2012-10-17', Statement: [{ Effect: Allow, Principal: { Service: [lambda.amazonaws.com] }, Action: ['sts:AssumeRole'] }] }
      Policies:

                Resource: '*'

    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.11
      Role: !GetAtt DriftGuardRole.Arn
      Code:

          import json
          def handler(event, context):
``` 

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

Tests practical, low-risk patch management for SAP on AWS with governance and rollback.

## Key Concepts

- AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager
- Patch Baselines and Maintenance Windows
- IAM roles for SSM
- CloudFormation automation

## Code Example

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  SAPPatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: '/'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SAPPatchAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:SendCommand
                  - ssm:ListCommands
                  - ssm:DescribeInstanceInformation
                Resource: '*'
  SAPOSPatchBaseline:
    Type: AWS::SSM::PatchBaseline
    Properties:
      Name: SAP-OS-PatchBaseline
      OperatingSystem: 'AMAZON_LINUX_2'
      ApprovalRules:
        PatchRules:
          - PatchFilterGroup:
              PatchFilters:
                - Key: 'CLASSIFICATION'
                  Values:
                    - 'Security'
                    - 'Critical'
            ComplianceLevel: 'CRITICAL'
            ApproveAfterDays: 0
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you extend this to multi-region deployments?
- How would you enforce change-control and auditing for patch events?
- How would you validate SAP service health after patches without impacting users?

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  SAPVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
  PrivateSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SAPVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
  PrivateSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SAPVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
  SAPInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sap"
      VpcId: !Ref SAPVPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetA
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  AdminRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'

      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SAPAdminLeastPriv

            Version: '2012-10-17'

              - Effect: Allow
```

```yaml
      RoleName: SSM-Patch-CrossAccount-Role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: arn:aws:iam::112233445566:role/PatchingAdmin

            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: true

            Version: '2012-10-17'

              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:SendCommand
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                Resource: '*'

    Type: AWS::SSM::Association
    Properties:
      AssociationName: SAP-Patch-Baseline-Apply
      Targets:
        - Key: tag:Environment
          Values: [Prod, Shared, DR]

      TaskType: COMMAND
      Parameters:
        Operation: [Install]
        PatchGroups: [SAP-Kernel-Patches]
```
